stories.title: Body found in California search is missing Utah Marine, father confirms
stories.summary: A body found Friday in Twentynine Palms, California, during an extensive search for a missing Utah Marine has been identified by his father as 19-year-old Marriner Richards.

stories.title: Exam shows that hat Fiona the hippo ate was deep into her small intestine
stories.summary: The Cincinnati Zoo said on Friday that a necropsy found that a knit hat Fiona the hippo swallowed nearly two weeks ago was caught in the middle of her small intestine.

stories.title: Tooele County Council member resigns after being charged with sex abuse
stories.summary: Tooele County Councilman Erik Stromberg is facing felony sex abuse charges based on incidents alleged to have occurred in 2023.

stories.title: Pick Six Previews: Utah to improve to 11-0 with a low-scoring win over TCU
stories.summary: Look for Utah to win the game, get to 11-0, but they will be tested into the fourth quarter in a low scoring game. The defense will force a late-game error on Craig, and Dampier will add to his resume.

stories.title: Minnesota woman faces 2 counts of second-degree murder in deaths of her children, 3 and 5
stories.summary: A southeastern Minnesota mother is charged with two counts of second-degree murder in the shooting deaths of her two young children.

stories.title: Box Elder County sheriff charged with automobile homicide for deadly crash
stories.summary: Box Elder County Sheriff Kevin Potter is facing criminal charges for his involvement in a crash that led to the death of a 22-year-old motorcyclist.

stories.title: Hurricane-based nonprofit partners with Indigenous leaders on upcoming Native American exhibit
stories.summary: Liberty Village in Hurricane is partnering with Indigenous leaders to launch Future Native Village, a new exhibit highlighting the vital role Native American heritage played in shaping U.S. history.

stories.title: Have You Seen This? Impossible hill climb leads to total carnage for dirt bike riders
stories.summary: Dirt bike rider after dirt bike rider tried unsuccessfully to conquer what appears to be an impossible hill climb.

stories.title: Man escapes from immigration detention in Salt Lake City
stories.summary: A man escaped from custody at the U.S. Immigration and Customs Enforcement processing center in Salt Lake City on Thursday, according to the agency, which is under the U.S. Department of Homeland Security.

stories.title: UHSAA takes first step toward 2027-29 realignment with debut of Competitive Realignment Index
stories.summary: The UHSAA board began realignment Thursday, finalizing its new Competitive Realignment Index and initial classification sizes.

stories.title: Nasdaq wipes out gains for the year as Anthropic IPO fails to quell AI nerves
stories.summary: A punishing sell-off in technology stocks intensified Friday, wiping out the Nasdaq Composite's gains for the year, as investors continued to pull money out of the once high-flying AI trade.

stories.title: Utah man charged with exploiting and enticing teen girl in West Virginia
stories.summary: A child sex abuse material investigation by FBI agents in Pittsburgh has resulted in the arrest of a Pleasant Grove man who now faces 18 felony charges.
